docs(scripts): rewrap powerline-font.py docstring (rich-demos-4cl)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(demos): Powerline probe re-finds its span each poll and asserts a web face, not a file's name (rich-demos-4cl)

Review (high): a repainted row stales a held CDP nodeId; the family name is
the generator's choice, not the site's; the raw U+E0B0 was invisible. Also
points the font generator's docstring at code-font.css.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(demos): demo terminals draw Powerline glyphs in the docs' Powerline face (rich-demos-4cl)

The demo shell's xterm named no font, so Powerline and Capsule joiners drew
as missing-glyph boxes. The @font-face and code font stack move out of
custom.css into code-font.css, which the theme imports and every demo shell
links; the mount passes #term's computed family to xterm.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(claude-sessions): the footer shows every hint's key as text (rich-demos-qmk) (#249)

* test(claude-sessions): the footer shows every hint's key as text (rich-demos-qmk)

The unescaped `\` hint that printed [/bold white on blue] was fixed in #208
with nothing pinning it. This renders the bar in all three modes and asserts
the exact plain text; with the escape removed it fails on the ticket's
symptom.

* test(claude-sessions): render the footer without writing to stdout (rich-demos-qmk)

Review: Console.print echoed every bar into the vitest output;
renderToString is the pure path.
